ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across ~90% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters providing high global contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the macro-structure. High-contrast white geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal tips (left and right). Multiple discrete circular white focal spots (diameter < 15 pixels) are scattered across the interior of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep pixel depth and a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge. A distinct irregular excision/notch is present on the inner portion of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular pixel aggregates located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Isolated circular white pixels (scars) are distributed across the central lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (light grey against dark grey) are visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or missing tissue section on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe. Extensive barnacle colonization visible as high-intensity white clusters at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray/turbulence (high-intensity white noise) occludes the lower central region where the fluke attaches to the peduncle.
